newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU aluminium can recycling rises 5.7 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: EU aluminium can recycling rises 5.7 pct in 1996.

text.p: Recycling of of used aluminium cans in Europe increased by 5.7 percent to about 75,000 tonnes in 1996, the European Aluminium Association (EAA) said on Thursday.
Quoting figures from Aluminium Can Recycling Europe (ACRE), the EAA said that at least 37 percent of cans were recycled to produce new beverage cans or higher quality products.
"The aluminium can already exceeds, four years ahead of of the official schedule, the minimum recycling targets of the EU directive on Packaging and Packaging Waste," the EAA said in a statement.
Taking account of increased public awareness and expansion of can collection facilities, it forecast an overall recycling rate of more than 50 percent by the year 2000.

For these reasons, the European aluminium industry urged the EU to take action against member states such as Denmark and Germany which hinder or ban marketing of aluminium cans on their local markets, it said.
